spec.name: Earnings drift v30
spec.notes: Post-earnings drift on the reported surprise.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.2, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 4%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's claim of a 2.2 Sharpe ratio and 7% annual return is concerning given the limited research log. While the strategy appears straightforward, the 'lucky_period' possibility, coupled with the relatively high transaction costs (10 bps) and the lack of out-of-sample validation, warrants caution. The absence of gateway review adds to the uncertainty. Paper trading is recommended to further assess robustness before deploying real capital.
